phrase.en: How far is it? — It's a short walk, just a short distance from here.
phrase.ru: Как далеко это? — Недалеко, всего несколько минут пешком.
phrase.es: ¿A qué distancia está? — Está cerca, a poca distancia de aquí.

text.ru: Расстояние — How far is it? Время в пути — It takes ten minutes to walk. Walk как существительное: a short walk.
text.en: Distance: How far is it? Time: It takes ten minutes to walk. A walk is also a noun: a short walk.
text.es: How far is it? It takes + tiempo + to + verbo.

examples.en: It takes ten minutes to walk there.

exercises.ru: Мы можем дойти до пляжа пешком.

Is there a good restaurant nearby?

answer: How far is it to the station?
